results.title: E kiwi [electronic resource] : will you come down from the forest roof?
additional_description:
Title from PDF cover (viewed on Mar. 2, 2011).
"Members of the CNI Iwi Collective have important decisions to make about our future. We need to decide how to make use of the 'assets' (land and cash) that  we received as part of our settlement with the Crown. Our decisions  will affect the lives of our people for many generations to come. On the one hand, this may seem like a heavy burden to bear. But on the other hand, it is because of our success in regaining control of our land that these decisions are now ours to make. Since the CNI Forests Settlement was signed, the Collective has been  investigating possible commercial uses for our settlement assets. An overview of the findings of this investigation is contained in this  booklet. It has been provided to help you and your whanau discuss  the exciting and challenging times ahead. This booklet contains a summary of three proposed economic development  strategies for the CNI Iwi Collective"--P. 1.
